entities.name: Soraya
entities.description: Last known Falconer of Aysen on Ulgrotha, able to speak the language of birds.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure who appointed the first falconer.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Realm watched over by the Falconer.

entities.name: Beast Walkers
entities.description: Beings who turn into crows to report danger to the Falconer.

entities.name: Mesa Falcons
entities.description: Great falcons respected by the Falconer.

relations.quote: one of the Beast Walkers would transform themselves into a crow, fly to the Aviary at Onella, and report to Soraya
